title: Padmé Amidala
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: A courageous and brave leader, Senator Padmé Amidala was also the secret wife of Jedi Anakin Skywalker. She wanted to end the war and join her husband lakeside on Naboo to have the children she was pregnant with. Unfortunately, he was plagued with visions of her death that drove him to the dark side and, because of his actions, she died in childbirth.
